input:
CATEGORY: 可是/却/而: semantic turn (Coherence: connectors)
definition: Use 可是, 却, 而, and 但 only when there is a real contrast, unexpected semantic turn, or concession. Do not add an adversative connector without that relationship.

HER NOTES IN THIS CATEGORY (3 distinct):
1 | no “semantic turn” relationship, so可是is inappropriate
1 | “而” is not appropriate, because here is no “semantic turn”
1 | “却” indicates unexpected semantic turn

HER CORRECTIONS (8 of 8):
[mengmu_samples#36/f5/p0/note/e0] ⟦可是⟧他很聪明  || her note: no “semantic turn” relationship, so可是is inappropriate
[mengmu_samples#48/f1/p0/note/e0] ⟦而⟧追求知识是很重要的  || her note: “而” is not appropriate, because here is no “semantic turn”
[pear_story#4/f23/p0/k0-1/e2] 但政府实行的改革经济一系列政策[就让→却使]他失业  || her note: “却” indicates unexpected semantic turn
[shennong_samples#47/f3/p0/k0/e0] [+但是]跟牛奶喝
[pear_story#4/f32/p0/k0-1/e0] [+但]据人类法律规定
[mengmu_samples#29/f2/p0/k0/e0] [-可是]孟子的妈妈一直很控制他
[mengmu_samples#49/f2/p0/k0-1/e1] 他才三岁[+，可是一直]的以后待在墓地里
[pear_story#4/f23/p0/k0-1/e0] [-但]政府实行的改革经济一系列政策就让他失业

output.rule: Use 可是, 却, 而, and 但 only when there is a real “semantic turn,” such as a contrast or an unexpected result. 却 indicates an unexpected semantic turn.
output.explanation_template: <wrong> → <correct>: there is no real contrast or “semantic turn” here, so do not use <connector>.

examples.explanation: 可是: there is no “semantic turn” relationship here, so 可是 is inappropriate.
而: there is no “semantic turn” here, so 而 is not appropriate.
就让 → 却使: losing his job is an unexpected semantic turn, so use 却.
可是 → delete: there is no real contrast or “semantic turn” here, so do not use 可是.

output.not_an_error: Use 却 when the result is an unexpected semantic turn.
